arguments.sql:
SELECT frpm."County Name", frpm."Charter School (Y/N)", COUNT(*) AS rows,
       MAX(frpm."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") AS max_rate,
       MAX(ABS(frpm."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" -
           frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)")) AS max_rate_difference
FROM frpm
WHERE frpm."County Name" LIKE 'Los Angeles%'
GROUP BY frpm."County Name", frpm."Charter School (Y/N)";
